summary: Iteration 6 verified the multi-product Job refactor. Created /app/backend/tests/test_multiproduct.py (12 pytest tests) covering: admin login, jobs list rollup (product_count/certified_count/product_names), migration integrity of the 2 seeded CY jobs (items[] with points + excel_reference + standards_used), Excel-vs-App validation returning has_reference=true and 0 FAIL for both seeded jobs (calc engine unchanged), multi-product job creation via POST /api/jobs, per-product workflow independence (item A pipeline readings→calculate→submit-review→review→approve while item B stays draft, then B independently certified — distinct verification_ids on each), per-item certificate PDF (returns %PDF), public /api/verify/{vid} resolving the CORRECT item's serial/cert-type, per-item pre-release-check, SRF at job level listing both products + public /api/srf/{token} + customer approve action, add/delete item endpoints (delete blocked on certified item = 400). ALL 12 backend tests PASS. Frontend also verified end-to-end via Playwright (admin login, Dashboard shows product counts, Jobs list shows 'N · M certified' chip, JobDetail exposes product-tab-0 chip + all 5 sub-tabs tab-overview/readings/calc/validation/certificate + workflow bar, SRF tab + Audit tab, NewJob 'Add Another Product' creates product #2 card with item-product-1). No bugs found in refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: list_jobs (server.py ~L545) does an N+M+M database lookup per row (customer + product per item). Fine for demo scale but should be batched (customer $in, product $in) once job/product volume grows.
verify endpoint (server.py ~L1166) uses find_one on nested items.certificate.verification_id — good; consider indexing 'items.certificate.verification_id' for scale.
hydrate_item ignores an unset product_id (empty string) but ObjectId('') would throw — guarded by truthy check. OK.
server.py has grown to ~1382 lines; consider splitting jobs/documents/auth routers into separate modules for maintainability (soft, non-blocking).
